working_definition: Dm3a is one of two transcriptomic subtypes (Dm3a, Dm3b) of Dm3 neurons newly distinguished in the Kurmangaliyev 2020 visual system atlas (GSE156455). Dm3 neurons are distal-medulla, amacrine-like, multicolumnar interneurons arborising in medulla layers M2/M3, implicated in form/orientation processing. The Dm3a/Dm3b split is defined by mutually exclusive marker expression; the specific discriminating markers and dendrite orientation were not yet cross-referenced to the connectome-derived Dm3 subtype definitions in FBbt (Ozel et al., 2021).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Distal medullary wide-field amacrine neuron whose cell body is located in the cell body rind of the medulla. It projects asymmetrically along layers M2 and M3A forming mixed morphology arborizations (Morante and Desplan, 2008; Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). The arborization is proximal to that of Dm15 in M2 and distal to Dm4, Dm12 and Dm20 in M3B. Its arbor has a distinct narrow and elongated shape, covering one column wide and 10 columns long. The arbors overlap significantly between cells, aligning with rows of medulla columns, and extending in one of two orthogonal orientations. It is a glutamatergic neuron (Raghu and Borst, 2011). There are two subtypes with different dendrite orientation, synaptic partners and gene expression (Ozel et al., 2021).

justification: FBbt has a specific 'distal medullary amacrine neuron Dm3a' term (FBbt:00052303) defined from Ozel et al. 2021, characterised by posterior-ventrally oriented dendrites and lack of bi expression. However, the Kurmangaliyev 2020 atlas (which predates Ozel 2021) defines its Dm3a/Dm3b split purely by transcriptomic markers not detailed in the report, and the mapping notes explicitly flag that the a/b subtype naming here is dataset-specific and may not correspond to FBbt's connectome-derived Dm3 subtypes. Without verified correspondence of the Kurmangaliyev Dm3a markers to the Ozel 2021 dendrite-orientation and bi-expression criteria, forcing an exact match to FBbt:00052303 risks a false assignment. A broad match to the parent Dm3 term (FBbt:00003770) is the honest classification: the cluster unambiguously IS a Dm3 neuron (distal medulla, amacrine, layers M2/M3, multicolumnar), but subtype identity requires cross-reference verification.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Dm3 neuron with posterior-ventrally oriented dendrites (Ozel et al., 2021). It can be distinguished from Dm3b based on its lack of bi expression (Ozel et al., 2021).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: The subtype term exists and shares the Dm3a label, but its defining criteria (posterior-ventral dendrite orientation; lack of bi expression per Ozel 2021) are connectome/transcriptome-derived from a later study. The report explicitly states the Kurmangaliyev 2020 a/b split may not correspond to these FBbt subtypes, so an exact match cannot be confirmed without curator verification of marker overlap.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Dm3 neuron with posterior-dorsally oriented dendrites (Ozel et al., 2021). It can be distinguished from Dm3a based on its expression of bi (Ozel et al., 2021).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Sibling subtype; included for completeness as it represents the alternative subtype assignment. Not selected for the same reason as Dm3a: the Kurmangaliyev subtype correspondence to Ozel 2021 subtypes is unverified.

recommendation: Retain the broad match to the parent FBbt:00003770 (distal medullary amacrine neuron Dm3). Curator reviewed the Ozel et al. 2021 Dm3a/Dm3b subtype definitions (dendrite orientation, bi expression) and found no evidence that the Kurmangaliyev 2020 transcriptomic Dm3a cluster corresponds to the Ozel Dm3a subtype, so the specific FBbt:00052303 term is NOT assigned.
